title: Epstein as the front for a project or special access program

tellings.quote: I don't think he was running the Jeffrey Epstein special access project or whatever it was.

plain: Eric Weinstein, a researcher and commentator speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, floats the idea that the financier Jeffrey Epstein was a front for a special access program, meaning a tightly restricted secret government project, running from the 1990s until 2019. In passing he says of someone that he doesn't think that person was running "the Jeffrey Epstein special access project or whatever it was." If true, it would mean Epstein's activities, including those on his plane and island, served a hidden official purpose.
